values.note: 2027 rates from the park: $32 electric, $22 non-electric; fall special $27 / $17 from September 22 (the camping page gives the off-season as October 15 to May 1). The $5 booking fee is online only; phone and in-person bookings pay none, the 3% card fee is gone and cash or check takes 3.9% off. Vehicle admission is extra: $7 a day, $16 a weekend, $19 a holiday weekend, $26 a year. A site takes up to 6 guests, plus $2 per extra guest.

summary: Park pages read: 2027 rates $22 non-electric / $32 electric, fall special $17 / $27 (was $12-27 with $7.50-$10 booking fees and a 3% card fee); online booking fee $5, none by phone or in person; 5.5% sales tax now added; 50-amp electric (new); CampLife booking URL added. Minimum stays, year-round season, booking dates and the note confirmed. Not waterfront kept.
flags: WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept. The campground map puts the beach sites (10 electric + 2 walk-in, sites ~121-131) and the lower loop (93-121) closest to Blackhawk Lake; on Esri imagery the beach-site clearing (~43.0258,-90.2908) has ~60-80 m of continuous woods between it and the shore, and the lower loop's nearest sites (93-100E) sit ~200 m from the camper boat mooring. No lake view either.
